research_rationale:
EO 12042 (Creating a Board of Inquiry to report on Labor disputes affecting the bituminous coal industry in the United States), signed 1978-03-06. The order creates a Board of Inquiry under the Labor Management Relations Act and names its three members; its text sets no termination date and provides that after the report the Board "shall continue in existence". First end: Section 2 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 12042," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17.
